feed.caption:
Screen time is easier to say yes to when you know exactly what's on the screen.

KidPad has no ads, nothing to buy inside the app and no accounts. It works fully offline and doesn't track anything. Photos your little one takes stay in KidPad's own gallery, not your camera roll.

Settings sit behind a grown-up PIN, and there are step-by-step guides on kidpad.app for locking the device to KidPad with Guided Access or App Pinning.

Swipe through, then grab it via the link in bio.
